text: Welcome to the garage. Touch nothing. Except the spin button. Spin that.
Uncle Vex says this machine is "mostly" safe. That's good, right?
Hah! Even a {damn} space monkey could hit that.
Oh geez, we actually won something!
Glorp eat coins? No? Okay. You keep.
Congratulations. I am contractually obliged to say that.
That win must be declared on form 77-B.
See? Science. Mostly luck, but science.
Holy {shit}! The multiverse just paid up!
Oh {crap}, oh {crap}, that's a LOT of coins!
Oh {fuck} yes! That's jackpot energy, baby!
Wealth detected. Recalculating my opinion of you.
SHINY! Glorp so happy Glorp might split in two.
Another universe where you're broke. Classic.
Statistically this is fine. Emotionally it is {shit}.
Your losses have been filed. In triplicate.
Maybe the next one? Please be the next one.
Spin it again. What's the worst that could happen? Don't answer that.
Glorp eat the bad luck. Glorp hungry anyway.
Two cores. TWO. Son of a {bitch}.
It was SO close! Why does the universe hate us?
Near-miss noted. Hope is not a refundable expense.
The cores are overloading! Grab something, we're jumping!
Not the rift! Not the {damn} rift again!
Splendid reel. I shall add it to my collection.
Do not mind me. Just borrowing reality for a moment.
Ooh, a rare one. Wrap it up, darling.
You're out of coins, genius. Here's a handout. Don't make it weird.
Level up. Your parents would be mildly impressed.
New level. Bigger bets. Worse decisions. I love it.
Containment breach! Everyone remain calm and complete form 9.
The orbs are loose! Grab them before they eat the {damn} house.
Why is it beeping? Uncle Vex, why is it BEEPING?
JACKPOT! I'm buying a new garage. And a better nephew.
Oh {fuck}. Oh {fuck}! We're RICH!
Glorp has never seen so many shinies. Glorp is crying.
And we're back. Nobody touch the cat. It has too many legs now.
We made it back! I think I left a shoe in that dimension.
